text_block_list.text:
Thanks for racing with me today! What
are you
planning to run next?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: I was thinking of the Arima Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text:
Really? I was thinking of running that
too! Here's
to having another good race
if we end up in it
together!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: I had a lot of fun racing with you today!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, same here! I'm looking forward to
next time!
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text:
So this is what the senior racers are
capable of...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
...I learned a lot today. I cannot let
things turn
out the same next time.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I wasn't able to win, but...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It was. I can sense my own improvement.
I'm sure
I'll be able to achieve better
results next time.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It seems both Spe and Rob Roy intend
to run in
the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
Guess you'll be seeing them on the track again,
huh?

text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is next up on Eishin
Flash's
schedule. The three of them will
undoubtedly
clash again the way things
are now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
You've already gone against the best two
racers, so you'll be fine.

text_block_list.text:
It is safe to assume that they will be my
greatest
adversaries in the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
So in order to win, all I must do is outrun
those
two. At least that makes things
simple.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
